The processing of affective prosody, which refers to the emotional tone or inflection conveyed through speech, is influenced by spatial attention in several aspects. Here are the key points from the retrieved matches that address this question:

- Affective prosody is partially processed outside the focus of spatial attention at early sensory processing stages.
- Spatial attention modulates the degree of emotional voice processing as a function of emotional valence.
- The plane of compensatory eye movements induced by horizontal semicircular canal ocular reflex is not always parallel to the axis of the horizontal semicircular canal stimulation.

In summary, affective prosody is processed in relation to spatial attention but its processing occurs outside of this focus.
